milestones.title: Mu-native MCP config and import resolution are correct
milestones.goal: Mu can resolve MCP config from Mu-native files and the approved import sources, including the local Figma definitions in `.factory` and Codex TOML, without carrying Pi-specific path assumptions.

verification.expect: Targeted config/import tests pass for Mu paths, `.factory` JSON imports, and Codex TOML imports.

verification.command: Review MCP config precedence and import parsing against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms Mu-native pathing/imports are correct or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Use disposable scripts to parse the real local `~/.factory/mcp.json` and `~/.codex/config.toml` and print the resolved Figma server definition.
verification.expect: The visible output shows Figma resolved from the supported import sources with Mu-native precedence.

milestones.notes: Close this milestone only after Pi-specific path assumptions are removed and the local Figma definitions resolve through Mu-native import logic.

milestones.title: HTTP MCP runtime can connect, discover inventory, and surface tools through Mu
milestones.goal: A generic HTTP-first MCP runtime can connect to a deterministic local harness, discover remote inventory, and expose a proxy-first Mu tool surface with correct call/result behavior.

verification.expect: HTTP runtime tests pass for connect/discover/call/degrade behavior against a local harness.

verification.command: Review MCP HTTP runtime/session ownership/tool mapping against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms generic runtime boundaries are intact or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Exercise the local MCP harness over HTTP and record connect/list/call output plus degraded-path behavior.
verification.expect: The harness shows real HTTP MCP behavior that Mu can consume, including failure-path evidence.

milestones.notes: This milestone proves the generic MCP runtime independent of Figma-specific auth/client restrictions.

milestones.title: Reload, resume, and visible MCP UX are correct
milestones.goal: Reload and resume fully clean stale MCP artifacts and the visible Mu status surface reflects connecting, connected, degraded, or auth-failed states without stale tool exposure.

verification.expect: Reload/resume cleanup and status-surface tests pass with no stale MCP registrations.

verification.command: Review reload/resume cleanup, indicator ownership, and stale-surface handling against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms cleanup correctness or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Run Mu in a temp config/workspace, open `/mcp`, trigger reload and failure/recovery paths, and verify visible MCP state transitions plus stale-tool disappearance.
verification.expect: The terminal surface shows accurate MCP states and no stale callable surface after reload or degraded resume.

milestones.notes: This milestone closes only after visible UX and runtime cleanup agree.

milestones.title: Figma pilot is proven through the real runtime path
milestones.goal: Mu can attempt the real Figma MCP path from imported config and either complete a meaningful authenticated Figma operation or surface explicit auth/client-compatibility failure without false success.

verification.expect: Figma pilot tests pass for config wiring and visible slash/status behavior.

verification.command: Review the Figma pilot layer against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms Figma remains a pilot on top of the generic runtime or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Run the real Figma MCP validation path through Mu and capture either authenticated Figma-specific result data or explicit auth/client-failure output.
verification.expect: Evidence shows either a real Figma operation through Mu or a truthful explicit failure mode with no false connected state.

milestones.notes: This milestone is the real-world proof gate for the mission.
